scope: B05 fixed recorded-input MotionSupervisor regression; no MPC solve, controller output replay, vehicle model or closed-loop claim.
initialization: Cold owner warmed by the complete retained interval starting above CREEP_SPEED; no preceding creep or held-stop state is imported.
input_selection: All owner consumption ticks in the requested interval are retained in original order, including repeated LP/model identities; no time resampling, clock normalization or interpolation.
plan_join: Exact controlsState.motionState.planMonoTime to longitudinalPlan Event mono_ns; modelMonoTime and producer instance also agree.
owner_clock: Exact controlsState.motionState.referenceConsumerMonoTime: controlsd passes this same clock to MotionSupervisor.
vehicle_join: Latest valid carState Event at or before owner_clock. The log does not expose the actual consumed carState ID; this bounded causal association is not proof of exact consumption.
command_join: First carControl Event after controlsState in its publication cycle, less than 1 ms later; every retained tick has longActive true and no pedal override.
consumer_release_strength: Tests derive the consumer-local release_accel from saved LP wire speeds/accels and constraint_accel using the recorded 0.5 s actuator delay plus DT_MDL.
limitations: The recorded vehicle trajectory includes the baseline CREEP braking response. Changing the owner cannot predict the resulting vehicle trajectory or prove B05 would no longer stop.
The route export is partial only at segment 34; this fixture is from complete segments 26 and 27 and has all successful, valid LPs with valid timing and no degraded/waiting state.
A separately seeded HOLD test is a controlled boundary test, not a statement that the recorded owner was held at interval start.
